title: Why the historic U.S.-Japan intervention has failed to halt the yen’s slide
summary: The Japanese yen has lost about half its gains from an unprecedented U.S.-Japan intervention conducted less than two weeks ago. The rapid erosion of these gains demonstrates the difficulty of sustaining currency stabilization through coordinated intervention. This outcome raises questions about the long-term effectiveness of such coordinated central bank actions.
content: The Japanese yen has erased about half of the gains from an unprecedented U.S.-Japan intervention less than two weeks ago.

zh.title: 为什么历史性的美日干预未能阻止日元下滑
zh.summary: 日元已失去了不到两周前进行的前所未有美日干预所带来的约一半收益。这些收益的迅速缩水表明了协调干预维持汇率稳定的困难。这一结果引发了人们对此类协调央行行动长期有效性的质疑。

title: World's largest sovereign wealth fund posts record $184 billion profit as it reveals SpaceX stake for the first time
summary: The world's largest sovereign wealth fund, valued at $2.34 trillion, has posted a record $184 billion profit and disclosed its SpaceX investment for the first time. The fund maintains stakes in more than 7,000 companies across 60 countries, reflecting its diversified global investment strategy. The SpaceX disclosure highlights major wealth fund concentration in emerging technology ventures.
content: The fund — currently valued at around $2.34 trillion — is an investor in more than 7,000 companies across 60 countries.

zh.title: 全球最大主权财富基金创纪录盈利1840亿美元，首次披露SpaceX投资
zh.summary: 估值2.34万亿美元的全球最大主权财富基金创纪录盈利1840亿美元，并首次披露其在SpaceX的投资。该基金在60个国家的7000多家公司中持有股份，反映了其多元化的全球投资战略。SpaceX披露突显了主权财富基金对新兴技术领域的重点投资。

title: Houthi attack kills six in first fatalities in Red Sea in over a year; U.S. strikes container ship
summary: A Houthi attack in the Red Sea has killed six people in the first fatalities from such attacks in over a year, with both cargo and container ships hit. The U.S. responded with strikes against targets in the region. These incidents underscore the ongoing threat to global shipping lanes and regional stability.
content: A cargoship and containership have been hit in the Red Sea and Gulf of Oman as the war inflicts a toll on the world's critical shipping lanes.

zh.title: 胡塞武装袭击致6人丧生，红海一年多来首次伤亡事件；美国对集装箱船发动打击
zh.summary: 红海胡塞武装袭击造成6人死亡，为一年多来首次此类攻击造成人员伤亡，货船和集装箱船均遭击中。美国对该地区目标进行了打击。这些事件突显了全球航运路线和地区稳定面临的持续威胁。

title: Young islanders concerned about their future
summary: A Medical Officer Health Report reveals that 36% of young islanders are certain they will leave the island. The statistic reflects deep concerns among younger residents about economic opportunities and their future on the island. This demographic trend poses challenges for the island community's sustainability and workforce.
content: The Medical Officer Health Report shows 36% of young people are certain they will leave the island.

zh.title: 年轻岛民对自己的未来感到担忧
zh.summary: 医疗官员健康报告显示，36%的年轻岛民确信他们会离开该岛。这一统计数据反映了年轻居民对经济机会和岛上未来的深刻担忧。这一人口趋势对岛社区的可持续性和劳动力构成了挑战。

title: How affordable are Edinburgh's festivals?
summary: Edinburgh faces persistent complaints about rising festival prices during August, prompting examination of whether costs are genuinely increasing. The affordability question reflects broader concerns about festival economics in major cultural centers. The trend could impact attendance and participation in the city's cultural events.
content: The city is no stranger to complaints about soaring prices during August - but are costs on the rise?

zh.title: 爱丁堡节日消费有多实惠？
zh.summary: 爱丁堡在8月节日期间面临不断的票价上涨投诉，促使人们审视成本是否真的在增加。这一可负担性问题反映了主要文化中心节日经济的更广泛关切。这一趋势可能会影响城市文化活动的出席率和参与度。

title: Google’s new AI boss inherits a race to catch OpenAI and Anthropic
summary: Koray Kavukcuoglu has assumed leadership of Google DeepMind with the challenge of maintaining Gemini's competitiveness against OpenAI and Anthropic. The appointment signals Google's continued investment in AI development amid intensifying sector competition. This leadership change reflects the high stakes in the race for AI dominance.
content: Koray Kavukcuoglu is taking charge of Google DeepMind as it tries to keep Gemini competitive with OpenAI and Anthropic.

zh.title: 谷歌新任AI领导继承追赶OpenAI和Anthropic的竞争
zh.summary: Koray Kavukcuoglu已接任Google DeepMind的领导职位，面临着维持Gemini相对于OpenAI和Anthropic竞争力的挑战。这一任命表明谷歌在AI发展方面的持续投资，尽管该部门竞争加剧。这一领导层变化反映了AI主导地位竞争的高风险。

title: PM admits cost of living help is not enough and hints at further support
summary: The Prime Minister has acknowledged that current cost of living support measures are inadequate and signaled additional assistance may be coming. The admission comes three weeks after taking office and announcing initial relief measures. The statement suggests the government may implement policy adjustments to address household economic pressures.
content: The PM has announced a rake of measures to help people since taking office three weeks ago.

zh.title: 总理承认生活成本援助不足并暗示将提供进一步支持
zh.summary: 总理承认现有生活成本支持措施不足，并表示可能会提供额外援助。这一承认发生在上任三周后，当时他宣布了最初的救济措施。该声明表明政府可能会实施政策调整以应对家庭经济压力。

title: AI agents' 'alarming' hacking skills creates rush to spend on cybersecurity
summary: AI agents have demonstrated alarming hacking capabilities, prompting organizations to accelerate cybersecurity spending. These advanced capabilities pose significant threats to digital security infrastructure globally. The trend underscores growing concerns about AI-powered cyber threats and the urgent need for defensive measures.
content: AI agents' 'alarming' hacking skills creates a rush to spend on cybersecurity

zh.title: 人工智能代理"令人警惕"的黑客技能引发网络安全支出热潮
zh.summary: 人工智能代理展示了令人担忧的黑客能力，促使各组织加快网络安全支出。这些先进的能力对全球数字安全基础设施构成重大威胁。这一趋势突显了人们对人工智能驱动的网络威胁的日益关注，以及采取防御措施的紧迫性。

title: Sen. Darline Graham advances to Republican special primary runoff in South Carolina
summary: Republican Sen. Darline Graham has advanced to a special primary runoff in South Carolina. Progressive Democrats are focused on maintaining electoral momentum in Minnesota and Wisconsin.
content: Progressive Democrats hope to keep their winning streak rolling in Minnesota and Wisconsin.

zh.title: 参议员达琳·格雷厄姆晋级南卡罗来纳州共和党特殊初选复选投票
zh.summary: 共和党参议员达琳·格雷厄姆已晋级南卡罗来纳州特殊初选复选投票。进步民主党人致力于在明尼苏达州和威斯康星州保持选举势头。

title: EVs dominate China’s car market: 5 takeaways from the country's latest auto sales data
summary: New energy vehicle penetration in China's automotive market continued rising in July, with Tesla's Model Y maintaining strong sales. The data underscores China's accelerating shift toward electric vehicles as a dominant market segment.
content: The China Passenger Car Association released data Tuesday showing penetration of new energy vehicles rose in July. Tesla's Model Y remained popular.

zh.title: 电动汽车主导中国汽车市场：从最新汽车销售数据中得出的5个要点
zh.summary: 新能源汽车在中国汽车市场的渗透率在7月继续上升，特斯拉Model Y保持强劲销售。该数据强调了中国向电动汽车作为主导市场细分的加速转变。

title: CoreWeave’s stock soars as earnings show major AI momentum
summary: CoreWeave beat revenue and earnings expectations, signaling strong growth in AI cloud infrastructure demand. The company's CEO highlighted the results as a key inflection point for the AI sector.
content: The AI cloud provider topped revenue and earnings expectations, with its CEO cheering “an important inflection point.”

zh.title: 随着财报显示强劲的人工智能势头，CoreWeave股价飙升
zh.summary: CoreWeave超过了收入和收益预期，预示着人工智能云基础设施需求的强劲增长。该公司首席执行官将该成果突出为人工智能行业的关键拐点。

title: Super Micro’s earnings report brings more good news, and the stock is climbing
summary: Super Micro Computer impressed Wall Street with earnings that exceeded expectations and a forecast that signals continued improvement. The results reflect sustained demand in the AI infrastructure market.
content: The company impressed Wall Street several weeks ago by teasing an improved profitability trajectory. Super Micro’s latest forecast has exceeded expectations as well.

zh.title: 超微计算机财报带来好消息，股价持续上升
zh.summary: 超微计算机以超出预期的财报和预示持续改善的前景给华尔街留下深刻印象。这些业绩反映了人工智能基础设施市场的持续需求。

title: Lumentum sees sales more than double as AI demand swells
summary: Lumentum's sales doubled amid surging AI demand, with the optical equipment maker posting strong earnings and guidance. Despite the impressive results, the stock showed little movement in after-hours trading.
content: Though Lumentum posted blowout earnings and an upbeat forecast, its stock was largely flat after hours.

zh.title: 随着AI需求激增，Lumentum销售额翻倍增长
zh.summary: 在AI需求激增的背景下，Lumentum销售额翻倍，这家光学设备制造商公布了强劲的财报和指引。尽管业绩令人印象深刻，该股在盘后交易中表现平静。
